options: Disposable local remote for automation; public origin only for the live gate
Exercise the public origin in automated tests
entries.question: Should repeatable automated acceptance use only a disposable local bare Git remote, reserving the public origin for the final live Nichthub landing gate?
entries.rationale: Superseded by the user-approved expansion from a bounded integration proof to an operational self-hosting alpha.

entries.final_answer: Expand to the operational alpha scope. Include policy amendment tooling; key rotation with distinct device identities rather than shared-key concurrent writers; selective bounded replication; shallow-clone handling; and a real two-identity public workflow. Keep secrets, runner network and quota hardening, portable/container backends, moderation/redaction, and merge queues for later focused missions.
